verdict: APPROVED scope clarification; original requirements approval retained
scope: Unchanged task 1.1a and corresponding isolated 1.4 tests only; no new specification, source acceptance or live authority.

clarifications.F1: Agree. Canonical identity availability requires a positive persisted-token/anchor match, never mere absence of an override. Within 1.1a, anchored positive simulation is an in-process fixture argument only. No CLI flag, environment variable, production records/file path, bootstrap or schema initializer may create or adopt live identity or provide live anchor authority. The current canonical schema remains unavailable. Test copied current schema, seeded stores and default-resolved clones as well as explicit overrides.
clarifications.F2: Agree. Live-profile reservations both block and occupy the slot in both orderings across reserve, history primaryActive and post-reservation has_other_primary. Derive profile from existing transactional data where possible; unknown active profile must fail closed. Include a real concurrent reservation test on isolated storage. Any unavoidable schema change requires explicit source-review disclosure; no silent live identity/schema adoption follows from this approval.
clarifications.F3: Agree. At least seeded-store, renamed-lineage and approval-ingestion RED/GREEN cases must exercise actual CLI -> load_snapshot -> history_reader keying. Hand-matched direct helper inputs alone cannot establish caller repair. If current caller key mismatch already denies history, retain that observation rather than misreporting it as a new RED failure. Fixture worktree-key variation must produce counted findings or unavailable history, never verified zero. Later live adoption still requires explicit key reconciliation.
clarifications.F4: Agree. Under existing corresponding implement semantics, every live non-repair kind is denied at sameDefectFailures >= 2 regardless of reproducerVerified/approachChanged. This includes live reproduce, verify, review, admin and report. Live repair retains the readiness exception requiring both flags. Reproduction can proceed under appropriate non-live actions; adding a live reproduce exemption would change the approved requirements.
clarifications.F5: Agree. Exact finalized-financial-settlement report and admin obey and occupy the primary slot and obey live history/retry guards. The unconditional ordinary report return must not precede the live-profile discriminator. Ordinary non-live report remains freely available, with existing non-live verify/review/reproduce semantics preserved.
clarifications.F6: Agree. Remove universal clear-all resolution: an APPROVED receipt with no explicit resolution list leaves findings intact; an explicit list may remove only named findings in its own lineage. Other-lineage names and unnamed findings remain. This is a guard on effect, not acceptance of source/specification/resource receipts as actual-result evidence. Exact closed receipt-label repair belongs to later 1.2; preserve fail-closed rejection findings.
clarifications.F7: Agree. All test destinations must be explicitly isolated from the live common directory. Compare database and WAL/SHM evidence and row counts across tests, retaining any concurrent observational-write attribution rather than asserting byte equality if bytes changed. Read-only inspection and no actionful test access to the live store or budget lock remain required.

implementationPrerequisites: Both same-candidate requirements approvals exist only for this scope.
Repair-test expectations must match these readings and relevant actual caller RED cases must exist before production changes.
A fixture error is not evidence of the intended production defect; correct it and inspect real failures before repair.
